pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

3. Best practice when working on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Roles of Creative Arts and Sports.

4. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.

5. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.

7. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   B. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   D. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.

10. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   C. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.

12. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   C. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Components of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Drawing and Painting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Craft and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. D — The speed of the music

3. A — Practise Roles of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

9. C — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

16. (4 marks)
